title: Scaffold name validation
responsibility: Validates safe project/code/field names and derives valid route, kebab-case and export names.

inputs.name: validateProjectName.name
inputs.description: Project name to trim and validate as a safe single name.

inputs.name: validateCodeName.name
inputs.description: Code name to trim and validate as a safe single name.

inputs.name: validateFieldName.name
inputs.description: Field name to trim and validate as a safe single name.

inputs.name: validateRouteName.name
inputs.description: Safe code name to convert to kebab-case route text.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.name
inputs.description: Name expected to already use lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by hyphens.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.label
inputs.description: Human-readable field label used in a kebab-case failure message.

inputs.name: validateExportName.name
inputs.description: Safe code name to convert to camelCase and validate as a TypeScript identifier.

outputs.name: validateExportName
outputs.description: CamelCase export name satisfying TypeScript identifier shape.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown for empty names, traversal/separators, unsafe characters, invalid kebab case or an invalid generated export identifier.
